title: [PP descriptors] Reconcile shipping-image rules, ownership and evidence across the PP boundary
body:
[A10] PP (protocol processor) descriptor-image contract coordination. Backlog; this issue first establishes ownership and executable evidence, not a blanket claim that parent checks are missing.

## Objective and evidence

Reconcile PP's image assumptions with the parent-generated shipping descriptors and identify exactly which repository enforces each rule. PP's public [L1-L10 contract](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/blob/8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58/docs/architecture/07_memory_maps.md#L78) assigns semantic checks to model lint, while these open PP issues report missing donor enforcement or propose integrator ownership:

- L9 identity validity and evolution: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/38
- ADP maximum stream counts across configurations: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/39
- L1-L8 descriptor-model semantics: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/60
- L10 AUDIO_UNIT offset/count/length and L6 clock-source-list shape: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/89
- Mixed donor umbrella, model-lint subset only: https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/82

The parent already has [model_shape/derive_model_id](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/blob/b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8/sw/builder/endstation_builder.py#L3252), generated descriptor construction and existing validators. A missing PP check does not prove the same product rule is unenforced. The missing management artifact is an authoritative, evidence-backed allocation of these obligations across both repositories.

## Authority and scope

Parent REQUIREMENTS REQ-VER-03/04, `docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md`, `avdecc/gen_aemi_image.py`, `avdecc/gen_aem_store.py` and its implementation helpers, `avdecc/aem_descriptors.py`, `sw/builder/endstation_builder.py`, `sw/builder/test_builder.py`; PP memory-map section 3.1, integrator guide, descriptor-image packer and the cited Milan/IEEE clauses in the donor contracts.

The parent owns shipping model content, its ADP metadata and the generated-image inputs. PP owns the generic packed-image contract and any checks retained in its packer. No ownership transfer occurs until the decision is public in both contracts.

## Acceptance

1. Publish one matrix covering L1-L10 and ADP stream-count maxima. Each row names the clause, producer/consumer, enforcing repository and path/check, supported configuration boundary, and existing issue for any open gap. Distinguish structural construction from a discriminating negative check.
2. Check all five tracked parent configurations against the PP assumptions. Record actual offsets, counts, lengths, source-list shape and advertised metadata; include the legal boundary and one-invalid-change probes needed to establish each claimed refusal. Do not claim multi-configuration behavior from the current single-configuration product alone.
3. Reconcile parent identity generation with descriptor bytes, including the existing generator-owned-field residue. Explicitly resolve PP versus parent lint ownership and update the affected authoritative contract before implementation relies on it.
4. Reuse the existing work items below. Any newly established product defect receives a bounded follow-up with evidence; do not silently expand their active criteria. This coordination issue can finish once ownership and evidence/dependencies are complete; it does not certify all implementation gaps closed.

## Existing owners and exclusions

- #478 exclusively owns the active parent eight-rate/duplicate refusal lane. Link PP89 there; do not append offset/length/L6 implementation to it.
- #495 already records model-ID evolution for generator-owned-only descriptor changes. Link PP38 without duplicating that repair.
- #464 owns the broken parent generator self-test and its CI wiring. Its repair does not by itself deliver every semantic rule.
- Closed #401/#463 record already-landed declaration and Identify reset-time work; do not reopen those fixes by copying their old observations.
- PP82's dynamic READ_DESCRIPTOR overlay and oversize response behavior stay in PP and #76 qualification, outside this model audit.

## Validation and readiness

The audit report must identify reproducible generator commands and decoded fields for each tracked configuration, and a source/check reference for every matrix row. Run the existing `python3 sw/builder/test_builder.py` when producing fresh executable evidence; report existing skips honestly. Use `python3 avdecc/gen_aem_store.py --self-test` only with its known #464 state explicitly recorded, never as an assumed passing gate. Expected audit result: no unowned rule, no unsupported pass claim, and every discovered gap linked to its execution contract. Any code/document changes subsequently follow their own issue and full CONTRIBUTING gates.

Unresolved decision: which generic semantic checks PP retains and which parent-only shipping checks it delegates. Record this before a rule-implementation lane is Ready. Executor: unassigned. Independent reviewers: unassigned. Coordinate shared builder files with #478, #464 and #400/#403; no active acceptance criteria change.
